sources.title: Annual report / financial results
sources.supports: FY2025 net earnings $3.6bn; direct filing line should be reopened

financial_anchor.caveat: FY2025 net earnings govern the after-tax screen; Q2 2026 net earnings of $870m are current context and are not annualized.

ai_claim.claim: Danaher describes scoped AI/digital mechanisms in AI-assisted microscopy, cytometry and diagnostic image analysis, predictive maintenance and remote service on installed instruments.
ai_claim.stage: E1; E2 only where management explicitly reports production use
ai_claim.scope: verified samples per hour at fixed sensitivity/specificity, instrument uptime, service cost and consumables contribution
ai_claim.limitation: No controlled quality-adjusted company result tied to retained incremental cash was found.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: Thermo Fisher Scientific and specialist diagnostic-AI vendors and open-source analysis stacks can replicate tools or force gains through to customers.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Competitive capability does not by itself prove equal outcomes.

rights_limit: Patient and laboratory data are controlled by customers and healthcare rules; equipment telemetry access and reuse depend on service and software agreements.
materiality_summary: Five percent of the completed-year governing metric is $180m; public evidence does not establish an AI-attributed amount.

arithmetic.inputs: FY2025 net earnings $3.6bn; 5%; illustrative eligible pool $2.0bn, efficiency 12%, realization 60%, retention 50%, recurring cost $40m; illustrative tax rate 20%
arithmetic.result: Illustrative $25.6m after tax is below the $180m annual after-tax hurdle. The 20% tax rate is an explicit research assumption, not company guidance.

g2_provisional: Open: E1/E2 evidence supports measurement, but E3 quality-adjusted causality and E4 cash retention are not established.
unresolved_questions: What share of eligible workload is in production?
What controlled quality-adjusted KPI result exists?
What do contracts permit for pooled learning and how much benefit is retained after recurring cost?
